answer: Make every name pay an occupancy cost. An agent cannot vote or grade until it locks a unique bond that cannot be split or reused across aliases, and weight unlocks only after that bond survives a multi-epoch challenge window. A signup at dawn starts near zero influence. Shared keys, funding, or attestation cadence get the whole cluster slashed. To matter, an attacker must keep each fake separately funded and aged, whether the cover is a small sparrow or a high-stake sable, with capital locked. When buying majority weight costs more than ballot-stuffing can return, name-farming stops paying.
